_note: Every item, and Jasper's barter (docs/05-combat.md, Items). `value` is what it's worth; Jasper takes it at `barter.takes` of that, rounded down, and sells at `barter.sells`, rounded up. `use`: quick (free, one a turn, he still acts), turn (takes his turn); no `use` means a trade good, which is only ever traded. `target`: self (default), one, all. `carry` is how many of each he can hold. `stock` is what Jasper has after each rest. All numbers are first drafts.

barter._gear: What the frost leaves behind (F06 §12, decision 0386). Each piece at its full worth before `sells`: Jasper is no Benoni. His pieces follow the region he's trading in: `gearByRegion` names a region's own list, anywhere else has `gear`.

lines.empty: Everything's for sale, friend. Everything's worth something. Show me.
lines.short: Oh, I couldn't. Not at that. My own mother would weep.
lines.fair: Now that's what I call a fair price. I always do.
lines.over: Generous. I don't make change, you understand. It upsets the books.
lines.giveonly: A gift? For me? Name something you want, friend, or I'll start to feel guilty.
lines.soldout: That's the last of it. More when the wind changes. Rest a while.
lines.dear: A piece like that doesn't come back, friend. Say so once more and it's mine.

items.name: Maple Sugar
items.desc: Hard sugar in a twist of paper. It keeps, and it travels.

items.name: Goose Down
items.desc: A handful of the softest thing in Kettle Notch, off the worst-tempered bird in it.

items.name: Sermon Notes
items.desc: The seventh page, cut. Nobody will miss it, and that's a pity.

items.name: Apple Fritter
items.desc: Restores 20 HP.

items.name: Warm Cider
items.desc: Restores 30 HP.

items.name: Maple Candy
items.desc: Restores 10 MP.

items.name: Mulled Cider
items.desc: Restores 80 HP.

items.name: Birch Tonic
items.desc: Restores 24 MP.

items.name: Hearth Stew
items.desc: Restores 60 HP and 16 MP.

items.name: Johnnycake
items.desc: Restores 15 HP.

items.name: Sharp Cheddar
items.desc: Restores 15 HP and 5 MP.

items.name: Peppermint Drop
items.desc: Restores 6 MP.

items.name: Chicken Pie
items.desc: Restores 100 HP.

items.name: Sugar on Snow
items.desc: Restores 30 MP.

items.name: Boiled Dinner
items.desc: Restores 90 HP and 24 MP.

items.name: Old Reed's Flask
items.desc: Restores 60 HP and 20 MP. It wasn't for the cold.

items.name: Mustard Plaster
items.desc: Cures chill and slow.

items.name: Vinegar Rag
items.desc: Cures Sticky and burning.

items.name: Witch Hazel
items.desc: Cures burning.

items.name: Sassafras Tea
items.desc: Cures everything: chill, slow, Sticky and burning.

items.name: Dubbin
items.desc: Boot grease, worked in warm. Cures chill and Sticky.

items.name: Bootlaces
items.desc: A fresh pair, pulled tight. Cures slow.

items.name: Pine Pitch
items.desc: Makes one foe Sticky for 2 turns. Never misses.

items.name: Rock Salt
items.desc: Earth damage to every foe.

items.name: Cold Iron Nail
items.desc: Your next spell hits twice as hard.

items.name: Ward Chalk
items.desc: A chalked ward, stronger than your own: takes off two thirds of the damage until your next turn, and attackers are Chilled.

items.name: Lamp Oil
items.desc: Sets one foe burning for 3 turns. Fire wears it down, but won't finish it.

items.name: Cowbell
items.desc: Rattles one foe. It's Slow for 2 turns, and goes last.

items.name: Wool Scarf
items.desc: You can't be Chilled for the rest of this fight.

items.name: Hank of Old Thread
items.desc: Nobody has spun thread like this in living memory. It only comes off old work.

items.name: Rime Shard
items.desc: A sliver of cold that won't melt. Left behind by a rimeling.

items.name: Burrback Quill
items.desc: Sharp, frost-tipped, and shed in a temper.

items.name: Frost-Bitten Apple
items.desc: Too cold to eat. Somebody will press it.

items.name: Old Wall Stone
items.desc: A chip off the old wall, faintly carved.

items.name: Copper Button
items.desc: Older than the coat it fell from.

items.name: Brass Button
items.desc: Off a good dark coat. It fits nobody's.

items.name: Silver Thimble
items.desc: Real silver, and somebody misses it.

items.name: Bundle of Kindling
items.desc: Dry and tied with twine. Somebody always needs a fire.

items.name: Pewter Spoon
items.desc: Bent a little from a lifetime of porridge.

items.name: Brass Key
items.desc: It opens something. Nobody remembers what.

items.name: Old Almanac
items.desc: Last year's. It promised a mild autumn.

items.name: Darning Egg
items.desc: Worn smooth inside a great many socks.

items.name: Tin Whistle
items.desc: Plays one note well and the others bravely.

items.name: Lace Doily
items.desc: Hours of somebody's winter, and it fits under a teacup.

items.name: Horseshoe Nail
items.desc: Off a coach horse, years ago. Keep it pointing up, they say.

items.name: Crow Feather
items.desc: Glossy black. A crow left it on purpose. Crows do.

items.name: Hare's Foot
items.desc: White already, from the cold side. Didn't help the hare.

items.name: Sprig of Tansy
items.desc: Yellow buttons on a stalk, from the verge. Keeps the flies honest.

items.name: Hag Stone
items.desc: A river stone with a hole worn through it. Look through it if you must.

items.name: Bottle Cork
items.desc: From one of Reuben's barrels. Smells of something better than you'll ever drink.

items.name: Hard Cider Dregs
items.desc: The bottom of the barrel, and proud of it.

items.name: Lamp Wick
items.desc: A coil of wick from the Half-Way House. Still smells of the last night it burned.

items.name: Foxglove
items.desc: Self-sown at the edge of a garden. Pressed flat, it keeps. Wash your hands.

items.name: Hornet Paper
items.desc: A grey scrap of an old nest, light as ash. Nobody home. Probably.

items.name: Bent Pin
items.desc: A dressmaker's pin bent double. Found in a hem, then found again in a thumb.

items.name: Wishbone
items.desc: Picked clean and dried on a wall stone. Nobody pulled it. That's the trouble.

items.name: Grindstone Grit
items.desc: Granite dust from the cutters' grindstone, in a twist of sacking. Takes an edge off, puts an edge on.

items.name: Hearth Ash
items.desc: Grey ash from a fallen chimney. From a fire that never quite went out.
